keyFindings: Improved posterolateral heel bevel creates a much nicer heel transition compared to its predecessor
Dual-layer midsole (stable Cloudtec base + Helion HF top) maintains a firmer platform overall despite maximum stack height, with noticeable bounce after a brief break-in period
Foam provides adequate snap for uptempo efforts and progression runs, but performs best at easier paces where rhythm flows naturally
Wide base and encasing sidewalls resist lateral motion, functioning as a stable neutral option suitable for runners needing guidance
Designed for daily training, long runs, and modest speedwork — more versatile for recreational runners than racing-focused efforts
Dual foam setup (PEBA Helion HF top layer over Helion base) delivers plush comfort with reported leg recovery after long efforts
Balances plush, supportive cushioning with enough energy return to maintain efficiency during longer runs
Segmented rubber outsole with Cloudtec hollowed areas provides ample flex points, keeping the shoe maneuverable despite its thick midsole
Grips well in challenging conditions including icy surfaces
Functions as a workhorse for easy long runs and recovery efforts — not intended for workouts or uptempo efforts
